ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast with approximately 65% low-intensity (black) and 35% high-intensity (white) pixel distribution across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity white region on the distal half of the right lobe with internal low-intensity mottling; left lobe is predominantly low-intensity black with high-intensity fringes at the inferior and superior margins.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serration profile along the trailing edge; peaks are more prominent and frequent on the superior edge of the right lobe compared to the left.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex trajectory sweeping upwards from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct white linear tracks; notable intersecting 'X' shape on the left lobe and several parallel vertical tracks on the lower right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive superficial linear rake marks across the fluke surface; significant protrusion of biological encrustations on the right fluke tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique cross-shaped linear abrasion on the upper-left quadrant of the visible fluke surface.
